title: manuscript-guard record of the sources copied from Zotero or from a folder of downloaded PDFs
description: Each file `manuscript-guard sync-sources` wrote under literature/sources/, by its name there: the work it is a copy of, the SHA-256 and size of what was written, whether it is Zotero's file, Zotero's text of a file, or a PDF of the folder named with `--from` and the DOI it was matched by, and the day. It is how the command knows which files are its own to replace when the copy they came from changes, and never writes over a file it did not write. It holds no path on anyone's computer.

from.description: `zotero`: the attachment's own file. `zotero-text`: Zotero's text of an attachment whose file is not on this computer or is an EPUB, the `.zotero-ft-cache` in the attachment's folder. `folder`: a PDF of the folder named with `--from`, whose name spells the work's DOI.

attachment.description: Zotero's key of the attachment, from its zotero:// link.

doi.description: The DOI of the work's entry in references.bib, as G7 reads it (undressed, in lower case), that the folder's file was matched by.
